title: Illinois Woman Realizes She Killed Two People
description:
A woman was accused of being responsible for the deaths of two adult men and the injuries of another in Moline, Illinois. Authorities said Chhabria Harris, 46, was taken into custody after she allegedly drove her Cadillac Escalade onto a walking path, hitting three people. Bodycam shows the aftermath of the crash and gives an insight into the investigation by police after arresting Harris. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
